page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-32-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the ARM64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the ARMv8 Neoverse-V2 processor running at 3.0 GHz, with one thread per core. The instance is equipped with 128 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, it includes 2412 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity spread across six local drives, while containing no GPU accelerators.

In benchmark evaluations, this instance demonstrates exceptional performance in memory and database operations. It achieves top-tier status in Passmark memory and database operations tests, alongside a strong Geekbench multi-core score. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 3959.92 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 163.3 GB/sec. It also exhibits strong performance in Redis SET operations, static web serving throughput, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression.

The c4a-standard-32-lssd offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring fast local storage and high memory throughput without the premium cost of x86 architectures. Its hardware profile and benchmark results make it highly suitable for database hosting, high-throughput web serving, software compilation, and text or image processing tasks.
